newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SBC in new venture capital initiatives.
newsitem.headline: SBC in new venture capital initiatives.

text.p: Swiss Bank Corp (SBC) said on Tuesday it is investing 50 million Swiss francs in about five venture capital funds, and will become a member of the European small cap screen-traded exchange EASDAQ.

Membership of EASDAQ, which stands for European Association of Securities Dealers Automated Quotation System, will enable SBC to support companies seeking a listing on the exchange, providing they qualify, the bank said.
SBC also said it would support the Swiss Venture Capital Centre in Basle, Switzerland, which plans to create an exchange to trade shares of start-up companies.

With respect to its investments, SBC said it would concentrate on Swiss growth industries like pharmaceuticals and biotechnology, medical technology, telecommunications, electronics and microtechnology.
The first venture capital fund SNB will participate in, together with Hoffman-La Roche, is called the "New Medical Technologies fund".
The fund aims to invest in 10 companies with major growth potential in biomedicine and medical technology, SBC said.
